Reviewed Tauri 2.12.1 and Wry 0.57 inspection defaults against the pinned sources, the default Cargo dependency, explicit native-devtools feature, static Nightly overlay, and generated Android/desktop/iOS channel overlays. Cargo resolves wry/devtools absent by default and present with opt-in on macOS, iOS, Android and Windows. Configuration mutation fails the focused suite; restoration passes 102 tests. Installed release inspector absence and Nightly/debug availability remain NOT_VERIFIED because packaging hit the host disk guard. The named threat is unintended inspection over OS/browser debugging access, not a hostile device owner or root.
